8 JUDGMENT [WP(C) Nos.26841/2023, 892/2023, 41797/2023] All the above three writ petitions were referred to mediation at Mediation Centre, Kerala High Court, and in the mediation, the subject matter of all the writ petitions were amicably settled and parties have entered into a compromise agreement.
The parties are agreeable for disposing of these writ petitions in terms of the compromise.
Hence, ail the writ petitions are disposed of in terms of the compromise agreement.
The compromise agreement will form part of this judgment.

The claim of the petitioner in W.P.(C).No.26841/2023 regarding Salvage, value of improvements,
interest on solatium, damages, or any further claims with regard to the fixation or disbursement of compensation are left open to be adjudicated before the appropriate forum in terms of Clause 9 [WP(C) Nos.26841/2023, 892/2023, 41797/2023] in the compromise agreement.
The Government shall disburse the compensation amount within one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
